title: Chicago, drawn by J. S. Wright according to survey, 1834
creator: John Stephen Wright
publisher: Historic Urban Plans, Ithaca, New York (facsimile)
coverage: Original Town, Wabansia, Kinzie's Addition, the School Section and the harbour
credit_line: Facsimile of J. S. Wright's 1834 manuscript survey. The original drawing is public domain and held by the National Archives, Washington, D.C.; the sheet shown here is the Historic Urban Plans, Ithaca, reproduction of it. The open-rights sibling scan of the same drawing is the Boston Public Library / Leventhal copy, commonwealth:js9577436, which source_url links to.
notes: The survey Hathaway's 1834 sheet derives from, and the master geometry source of the 4D reconstruction. The printed caption records the sheet's wear: "Signs of wear are apparent. Two portions are missing, the larger being near the lower center. At one time the drawing was torn to this spot from the upper right margin. Later the manuscript was mounted on cloth to repair this tear" - nothing inside those two losses is Wright's ink. Georeferenced in this project: the BPL master's control is chicago/4d/data/traces/gcp/wright_1834_gcps.json, and this 5050x6628 px sheet is registered in its own pixel space in chicago/4d/data/traces/gcp/wright_1834_nara_hup_gcps.json (source id wright_1834_nara_hup). The two scans are one drawing photographed twice, and neither is a second witness to the other.
